info.title: camofox-browser
info.description: Anti-detection browser automation server for AI agents. Accessibility snapshots, element refs, session isolation, cookie import, proxy rotation, and structured logs.

post.summary: Attach a file to an upload control
post.description: Attaches files from the configured upload directory without going through the native OS file dialog. Set CAMOFOX_UPLOADS_DIR to a directory that contains the files (default: ~/.camofox/uploads). Two strategies are tried in order: (1) if an <input type="file"> is already present, call Playwright setInputFiles on it directly (works for hidden inputs); (2) otherwise arm a filechooser listener, activate the trigger element (ref or selector) via keyboard (focus + Enter) then a forced click as fallback, and call setFiles on the resulting chooser. Each path must be an absolute path that resolves inside the configured upload directory.

path.description: Absolute path, or array of paths, that resolves within CAMOFOX_UPLOADS_DIR.

ref.description: Trigger element ref (e.g. e36). Optional when an input[type=file] already exists.

selector.description: Trigger element CSS/Playwright selector. Optional when an input[type=file] already exists.

timeout.description: Overall budget in ms to wait for an upload UI (in-app panel input or native file chooser) to appear after the trigger is activated. Ignored values (non-numeric or <= 0) fall back to the default.

400.description: Bad request (missing path/userId; non-regular file; or a path that is missing or outside the configured upload directory).

post.summary: Extract data from a page as JSON
post.description: Two modes. Send schema for the fields it names (uses refs from the last snapshot; returns 409 if there is none). Send kinds, or nothing, to read the page itself: tables (with headers), prices, schema.org JSON-LD and listings. Kinds mode is read-only and needs no snapshot. Refused with 409 human_in_control while a person holds the tab. Send either schema or kinds, not both.

schema.description: JSON Schema (type object) with x-ref hints. Schema mode.

kinds.description: Kinds mode. Any of tables, prices, json_ld, listings. Defaults to all.

200.description: Extracted data. Schema mode returns data; kinds mode returns the requested parts.

400.description: Invalid request (missing userId, bad schema or kinds, or both schema and kinds).

409.description: A person holds the tab, or (schema mode) no refs yet.

422.description: Schema mode could not satisfy a required property.

post.summary: Hand a tab to a person
post.description: Pauses agent actions on the tab. Action routes return 409 human_in_control until the handoff ends. The person works in the live view: create a control link with POST /live-viewer/links and control set to true. The handoff ends when the person presses Done, when the agent calls /handoff/release, or after idleMs with no input. Only the tab owner (userId) can start a handoff. Starting a new handoff replaces an active one.

reason.description: Shown to the person and in 409 responses. Max 200 characters.

idleMs.description: Idle time before control returns to the agent. Clamped to 10 seconds to 30 minutes. Default 10 minutes.

post.summary: Return a tab to the agent
post.description: Ends an active handoff so agent actions work again. Safe to call when no handoff is active.

post.summary: Check the page and hand off to a person when one is needed
post.description: Reads the page state. When the page is a captcha, a sign-in wall or a verification-code prompt, starts a handoff so the agent pauses and a person can act. Other page states never start a handoff. Idempotent: if a handoff is already active, nothing new starts. To give the person a link, create a control link with POST /live-viewer/links (control true).

idleMs.description: Idle time before control returns to the agent. Clamped to 10 seconds to 30 minutes.

200.description: Page state, and the handoff if one is active.

started.description: True when this call started a new handoff.
